_about: Where text sits on the RBC screens. Boxes are pixels on a 1920x1080 screenshot. At run time each group is found by its green title bar ('anchor') and its boxes move and scale with that bar, so any window size works. Box = [left, top, right, bottom, mode, psm]; mode 'yellow' keeps only yellow text; psm 7 = one line, 6 = a block of lines. Measured from real screenshots (tests/fixtures/screens).

dialog._what: Between-round window: quest choice, bee pick, upgrade shop

upgrade_shop._rows: row n is these boxes moved down by n * pitch

hud._what: Round panel on the right during a round
